desc: As its name implies, the Boo Boo(R) Pouch was designed to hold non-essential essentials like a phone, chap-stick, snivel kit, earplugs, wallet or whatever smaller items may be needed. The lid is made from a single piece of ULTRAcomp(TM) laminate for a thinner, stronger, and more water resistant closure. The Boo Boo(R) Pouch has two elastic loops inside to aid in organization.
